blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `sdk.admin.currency` set of methods used to send requests to Medusa's Admin API routes.

This method retrieves a paginated list of currencies. It sends a request to the
[List Currencies](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#currencies\_getcurrencies)
API route.
